name: Unitree G1
description: A mass-market humanoid robot designed for general-purpose applications, gymnastics, and high-precision task execution. It features advanced joint flexibility and has been successfully teleoperated via VR headsets to assist in surgical procedures.
keyFeatures: Features 29 to 43 degrees of freedom (DoF) across the body depending on the configuration
Arms support 7 degrees of freedom for human-like manipulation and precision control
Supports dynamic teleoperation using real-time onboard camera streaming and motion controllers
curatorNotes: Handled as "open-weights/open-source ecosystem" due to Unitree's open SDK for robotics developers. Original release was in 2024, but featured in the 2026 news cycle for its novel teleoperated surgical application by UCSD.
